# Calm Frames, Quiet Background

This release fixes the Retry notice that came back over a working map, and stops the card from reloading Windy when nothing on the map needs to change.

## The stall notice

- **A retried map is no longer flagged as stalled again.** Before, after pressing Retry the next Home Assistant update restarted the 15-second clock without a following load, so the "Windy did not respond" notice came back over a map that was working. Retry now reloads the frame directly and the notice stays away once Windy has loaded. _[#79]_
- **A tab switch no longer leaves a false notice behind.** Before, switching from the map to the forecast within 15 seconds kept the map's clock running, and it then marked the healthy forecast as stalled. The card now drops the clock of any frame that is no longer shown. _[#79]_

## Fewer reloads

- **The overlay loop pauses while the page is hidden.** Before, `overlay_loop` kept switching layers in a background tab or a minimised window, and every step is a full Windy reload, about 120 an hour with two layers and the default delay. The loop now skips its steps while the page is hidden and carries on when it is visible again. _[#79]_
- **A parked tracker keeps the map still.** Before, a phone parked near a rounding boundary flipped between two rounded positions on every GPS fix, and each flip reloaded Windy. The card now only moves the map once the tracker is about 200 m away from the last centre. _[#79]_
- **`update_interval` no longer moves the map to a place the tracker has left.** Before, a tracker that went from A to B and back to A within the interval left the pending move to B in place, so the map jumped to B although the tracker was back at A. The pending move is now dropped when the tracker returns. _[#79]_

## Upgrading

Update through HACS and reload the dashboard resource (a hard refresh of the browser is enough). No configuration changes are needed.
